title: Hero LCP Image: Naive vs Prioritized Responsive
description: Compare a lazy-loaded un-sized against a fetchpriority=high, intrinsic-sized responsive image.

before.label: Naive (Delayed LCP + Layout Shift)
before.previewNote: Lazy loading stalls LCP discovery; missing width/height shifts content on load.

after.label: Prioritized Responsive (Fast LCP, Zero CLS)
after.previewNote: Preload scanner fetches exact AVIF width immediately with high network priority.
